map.判定精液液化状态，正常液化通常在 15~30 分钟内完成，60 分钟未液化为异常: Assesses semen liquefaction status; normal liquefaction usually completes within 15-30 minutes, and failure to liquefy within 60 minutes is abnormal.

map.精液液化时间分级：不超过30 分钟正常、30–60 液化延迟、60–120 液化: Semen liquefaction grading: <=30 min normal, 30-60 min delayed, 60-120 min incomplete, >=120 min non-liquefaction; viscosity is assessed by thread length, <2 cm is normal.
map.显著影响精子活力与受孕: Significantly affects sperm motility and conception
map.：精囊分泌凝固蛋白使精液凝固，前列腺分泌的 PSA 液化酶使其液化: : Seminal vesicles secrete coagulation proteins to coagulate semen; prostate-secreted PSA liquefies it.
map.：液化不全会限制精子运动，影响精液常规分析与受孕: : Incomplete liquefaction limits sperm movement and affects routine semen analysis and conception.
map.：实验室可用机械吹打、37℃孵育、菠萝蛋白酶等辅助液化: : Laboratories may use mechanical pipetting, 37℃ incubation, bromelain, etc. to assist liquefaction.
map.：前列腺炎、感染、先天性精囊/前列腺异常: : Prostatitis, infection, congenital seminal vesicle / prostate abnormalities.
map.提示：检测应在取精后尽快开始，建议 37℃ 恒温水浴中观察。拉丝过长提示粘稠度异: Tip: testing should begin as soon as possible after ejaculation, preferably in a 37℃ water bath. Excessive thread length suggests abnormal viscosity and may coexist with incomplete liquefaction.
map.WHO 参考：室温下 ≤60 分钟完全液化；30 分钟液化属正常。: WHO reference: complete liquefaction within <=60 min at room temperature; liquefaction at 30 min is normal.
map.超过 60 分钟未液化或粘稠拉丝>2cm，提示液化异常，可影响计数与受孕。: Failure to liquefy after >60 min or viscous thread >2 cm suggests abnormal liquefaction, which may affect counting and conception.
map.射精后 15–30 分钟逐渐液化，参考上限 60 分钟。: Gradual liquefaction 15-30 minutes after ejaculation; reference upper limit is 60 minutes.
map.常与前列腺分泌酶不足、炎症相关，可酶处理助检。: Often related to insufficient prostatic enzymes and inflammation; enzymatic treatment may assist testing.

map.内完全液化；超过 60 分钟仍为胶冻状称为液化不全（迟缓液化）。: achieves complete liquefaction; remaining gel-like beyond 60 minutes is called incomplete (delayed) liquefaction.
map.液化延迟可限制精子活动与穿透，关联前列腺炎、精囊腺功能异常等；长期液化不全可能影: Delayed liquefaction limits sperm activity and penetration, and is associated with prostatitis and seminal vesicle dysfunction; long-term incomplete liquefaction may affect natural conception.
map.液化时间受留取温度与容器影响；评估需结合精液量、活力、浓度等参数，由男科/生殖科: Liquefaction time is affected by collection temperature and container; assessment should combine semen volume, motility and concentration, with comprehensive judgment by andrology / reproductive medicine.
